binding: registered skeleton (profile files rig.npz); skin regions come from each asset's own vertex weights
note: Each skin vertex belongs to the region of its dominant weight. Side from the bone suffix _l/_r; unmatched bones are body. Clothes_Hidden masks are ignored for witnesses: the skin under clothing is the collision surface (cloth thickness is not modelled in v1).
inside_test: generalized winding number |w| > 0.5 on the open target region
